profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Capital One
profile.summary: Hello, I'm Anthony, currently a software engineer at Capital One working in the account opening and online engagement space. I graduated from Penn State in May 2021 with a B.S. in Computer Science as well as with honors from the Schreyer Honors College. During my time at Penn State I was a Technology Captain with THON, a moderator for World in Conversation, and a lifeguard with PSU Aquatics. My honors thesis was a look into different techniques for analyzing clusters in a centroid based learning algorithm for indoor scene classification.
